restore_steps_if_requested_later: Read ARCHIVE_LOCATION.json in the exact original retired directory, or locate the same directory in the signed source manifest.
Confirm sufficient A100 disk capacity before restoring; never redirect the restore into active runs or unrelated folders.

Copy that exact archived directory from the4080 archive root back under the original A100 cold root, preserving its original filenames. The small location-pointer file may remain alongside restored originals.

Check restored file sizes and SHA256 values against ARCHIVE_MANIFEST.json before use. A relocated full checkpoint may represent only its recorded byte identity, never a different missing earlier parent.
